moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio list-cascade, written here): Four rows, 60 ms apart (820 ms in all): y −20 → +3 px in 384 ms power3.out, then +3 → 0 in 256 ms power2.inOut (640 ms each); opacity 0 → 1 over the first 400 ms (power2.out). A side rail of dots lights as each row lands (guide). Params: from (−20 px) · dip: lún quá (3 px) · stagger (60 ms) · each (0.64 s). 0.384 s power3.out past the slot, then 0.256 s power2.inOut back: 0.64 s each.
